summary: The Bachelor in Computer Science (PO 2026) awards 180 CP over six semesters, including a 15 CP bachelor thesis. Compulsory blocks are Grundbereich A (25 CP), Grundbereich B (24 CP), the Hauptbereich (60 CP), Projektarbeit (12 CP), and two named seminars of 3 CP each. Elective rules cover 12 CP in technical and practical computer science, 6 CP in theoretical computer science or mathematics, 6 CP in a technical and practical lab, 6 CP in a theoretical computer science or mathematics lab, and 8 CP of key competencies, of which Lernen und Organisation (2 CP) is compulsory and 6 CP are chosen from the interdisciplinary offerings. Faculty-council Ergänzungen may add further modules to those elective areas.

categories.name: Technical and practical electives
categories.note: Section 7 requires 12 CP in Wahlpflicht technische / praktische Informatik. Every module of this pool in the handbook is 6 CP, so the area is two modules. Symbolische künstliche Intelligenz und diskrete Datenanalyse is part of this pool and is offered under the Ergänzungen area path.

categories.name: Theory and mathematics electives
categories.note: Section 7 requires 6 CP in Wahlpflicht theoretische Informatik / Mathematik. Handbook modules in this pool are 6 CP each, so one module fills the area.

categories.name: Technical and practical lab
categories.note: Section 7 requires 6 CP in Labor technische / praktische Informatik. Labs in the handbook carry 3 CP, 4 CP, or 6 CP, and HackerLab may be credited with 3 CP or 6 CP, so the area is complete when the chosen labs reach 6 CP.

categories.name: Theory and mathematics lab
categories.note: Section 7 requires 6 CP in Labor theoretische Informatik / Mathematik. Handbook labs in this pool are 6 CP each, so one lab fills the area.

categories.name: Key competency electives
categories.note: Section 7 gives key competencies 8 CP in total. Lernen und Organisation (2 CP) is compulsory under section 7 (5), and the other 6 CP come from the Wahlpflicht module Schlüsselkompetenzen aus dem fachübergreifenden Lehrangebot.

categories.name: Project work
categories.note: 12 ECTS; requires Grundbereich A and B.
